Ana (docs): Quick heads-up — PR #6789 (migration-guide) preview failed linkcheck + vale. Linkcheck 404 on /old-sdk-path, vale flags passive voice in H2s.
CI Bot: docs-preview failed for pr-6789 — linkcheck, vale. See: https://ci.internal/redwood/prs/6789/preview 
Ana (docs): Paste of CI snippet:
```
FAIL linkcheck: http://example.com/redwood/old-sdk → 404
VALE: H2 'Why the migration is needed' -> passive-voice (VALE001)
```
Mike (eng): I can fix the link, might need to update redirect. Do we want a followup PR or patch in this branch?
Ana (docs): Prefer patch in same PR if small. Need reviewer timeout — Lane is OOO. @Sarah could you take a look at vale/style?
Sarah (devex): I can do a quick pass tonight — will check headers + style. ETA ~2h :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Lane (docs): back tomorrow morning, can do final approve after Sarah.
Mike (eng): For the redirect, infra change might be required. I'll open infra ticket if needed, but first try updating docs link to new path.
Ana (docs): Also flagging that this PR is bumping the migration guide right before RC freeze — if we fix lint by EOD, can squeeze into Wednesday merge window. Otherwise hold to next cycle.
Docs Bot: Reminder: merge window rules — docs changes that touch migration guides require 2 reviewers and CI green.
Ana (docs): Plan: Sarah fixes vale, Mike changes link, I’ll run local linkcheck then repost preview. If green, @Lane will approve AM and I will merge during Wed window. Any objections?
Mike (eng): Sounds good. I'll send draft infra ticket if link needs redirect. No objections.
Sarah (devex): Taking vale pass now.
CI Bot: Started preview job for pr-6789 (rerun requested by Ana).
Ana (docs): tagging thread so reviewers see plan. Thanks all :pray:
